title: Kate's Mach-E shortlist
subtitle: Used Ford Mustang Mach-E · all trims & batteries · full 250-mi corridor · best match for Kate first
intro: Every Mach-E we can find within 250 miles — now the full corridor, not just a shortlist. Cars just added from the latest scan are tagged 🆕 Just added, standouts are ⭐ flagged, and the list is sorted by best match for you (Premium + glass roof + good value rise to the top). Use the filters up top to narrow (AWD, sunroof, Extended Range, certified, under $31k), tap 👍/👎, then hit "Send my picks."

resources.label: Read up on the Mustang Mach-E — reviews, specs & pricing (Autotrader)

tradeoffs.headline: What each feature actually costs
tradeoffs.note: Median asking price across every Mach-E in range (widened 2026-08-10). Filter the list to see the specific cars behind each lane.
bullets: Cheapest overall right now: $22,490. Premiums with the glass roof start around $25,999.
AWD vs RWD: AWD runs about $2,532 more at the median.
Extended vs Standard Range: Extended costs about $2,207 more, but Standard Range is fine for around-town driving.
Premium vs Select trim: Premium runs about $4,269 more — Premium adds the panoramic glass roof (2023) and B&O audio; Select has neither.
Sunroof: standard on Premium/GT, never on Select. On 2024 Premiums it was optional, so those show "verify."

standardFeatures.heading: 🛡️ Standard safety on every Mach-E (Ford Co-Pilot360®)
standardFeatures.note: Every Mustang Mach-E ships with Ford's Co-Pilot360 driver-assist suite as standard — including automatic emergency braking and blind-spot monitoring — so these come on all the cars below, regardless of trim or year.
items: Pre-Collision Assist w/ Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB)
